literal: Triumph attaining true reality they do not see, hostility pursuing harmful intellect they who have.
translation: Those of harmful intellect who cherish hostility cannot perceive the true reality that leads to triumph.
modern: பகைமையை விரும்புகின்ற தீய அறிவுடையவர்கள், தமக்கு வெற்றியைத் தரும் மெய்யான பொருளை அறிய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains how hostility blinds a person's intellect. Those who harbor a harmful mind and actively pursue discord (இகல்) are unable to see the true reality (மெய்ப்பொருள்) that actually leads to lasting success or triumph (மிகல்). Their obsession with conflict prevents them from understanding what is truly beneficial, leading to their own downfall.
